step1.title: We listen
step1.text: We listen carefully and understand your needs.

step2.title: We advise
step2.text: We advise you and together decide on the best service for the person to be cared for.

step3.title: We assess
step3.text: We thoroughly assess the condition of the person to be cared for with a psychologist or social worker.

step4.title: We select
step4.text: Together we'll select the professional who best fits the person being cared for.

step5.title: Enjoy
step5.text: We start the service and provide ongoing follow-up to ensure quality of service.
